entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
When you're a New Zealand exporter entering a large, complex global market, you need to target in order to be successful. Marketing expert and NZTE Beachhead advisor Becky Lloyd explains how to define your bullseye customer, and how it will help you resonate with your target audience to increase your chance of success.

https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/20251013-get-insights-from-expert-global-business-advisors
